meta.originalText:
THE TENANT MUST NOT DISCLOSE CUSTOMER DATA UNLESS THE CUSTOMER HAS GIVEN WRITTEN CONSENT.
Tenant may occupy unless rent is not due, and only if the permit remains valid.
If written notice is received, the supplier shall deliver the records, except where a court prohibits disclosure.
Confidential Information means records described in Section 4.2.
The Montréal office may retain the record 🦉 until the audit is complete.
An observer reported that the tenant must destroy the records.
Tenant may inspect the ledger provided that payment is received, subject to Section 7.
Notwithstanding Section 8, the agent shall preserve this original phrase.
